releaseNotes.summary: v1.0.0-release - Major dashboard and API improvements, expanded admin controls, smarter code parsing and RAG inference, dynamic documentation, request cancellation, rate limiting, and 26 new tests
changes: *btw i was planning on 2 releases/devlog BUT i got carried away so itll be split into 2 parts
fixed a CSRF token bug that prevented users from retrying login after entering an incorrect password
added 7 new admin controls: `delete-event`, `delete-error`, `delete-event-group`, `delete-error-group`, `delete-events`, `delete-errors` and `logout`
shortened/changed `/api/admin/errors` and `/api/admin/events` endpoints to group requests/errors by stack/occurrences instead of individual requests/errors
added a `Retry-After` header to `/admin/login` when the user is rate limited to show how long they have to wait before retrying
overhauled the event and error pages to show more information and allow for deleting individual events/errors or entire groups of events/errors
enabled dragging and resizing for all panels through a custom DOM-based interaction system (panel positions and sizes do not persist and mobile interactions are disabled)
made the sidebar collapsible and resizable (these persist through localStorage)

improved AI page styling and fixed a bug where `

` elements turned grey due to CSS specificity conflicts with styles loaded from other pages
overhauled API page styling and made the API page dynamically load from `/api/routes`
added request cancellation to the AI page with a Stop button powered by AbortController
overhauled Commands page styling, added filtering/sorting for commands, and made each command interactive with an attached execution action
made `Docs.jsx` dynamically load documentation with search and navigation
made Not Found pages have an error stack trace.
[code parser] added support for named CommonJS exports (e.g. `module.exports = { foo, bar }`)
[code parser] added support for destructured CommonJS exports (e.g. `const { foo, bar } = require('module')`)
[code parser] added method inference for functions without their own routes
[code parser] added a cross-file inference pass inside `buildIndex`
fixed `.rag` generating the `server` directory instead of the root directory
temporarily removed the `getMetrics` RAG tool since it provides useless/redundant information
added 2 new tool to RAG: `runAPICommand` and `runTerminalCommand` for executing internal API and terminal commands from RAG
removed `css` from RAG allowed file extensions due to redundant information
enahanced RAG to include more information about images, and have better keyword boosts for scoring
fixed `/api/routes` endpoints not returning the inferred HTTP method for `/api/session`
added 429 rate-limit handling to `POST /api/commands` (15 requests/45sec, 0.5s db between eachh request) and `POST /api/ask` (10 requests/5min, 15s cooldown)
moved /api/admin/server-events to /api/admin/events and moved the existing unused /api/admin/events SSE stream to /api/admin/summary/stream
added a new url query parameter `?level=critical|success` to `/api/admin/events`
added 24 new tests for documentation functionality and 2 new tests for resolving routes (`/api/routes`)
added a new workflow to synchronise current documentation into the GitHub Wiki (https://github.com/slackzilla/slackzilla.wiki.git)
added 9 local terminal commands: `help`, `cls`, `history`, `storage`, `whoami`, `version`, `terminal`, `refresh`. `time`
added 7 backend-connected terminal commands: `status`, `uptime`, `logs`, `api`, `docs`, `rag`, `command`, `sudo` within each of them there are flags and arguments, some are directories
added an embedded terminal at `/terminal` using xterm.js and FitAddon
introduced a terminal command system with command parsing, dispatching, command history and interactive contexts
added terminal commands for inspecting API routes, documentation, RAG status and sources, and registered Slack commands
added API route listing and inspection through the terminal
added documentation listing and search commands, including source limits and an option to omit verbose excerpts
added interactive command contexts for executing registered Slack commands and supplying arguments
added virtual command directories with `dir`, `cd`, `exit` and parent-directory navigation
added terminal utilities for text encoding, JSON formatting, timestamps and command history
added `sudo` support for administrative terminal operations
integrated privileged operations with the existing admin control API and master-password re-authentication
added operation confirmation for privileged actions
added terminal logout support through `sudo logout`
added filtered status output for administrative terminal commands
added terminal session history restoration and ANSI output preservation

scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently --names "BOT,SERVER" "npm run bot" "node server/server.js"
scripts.build:preview: vite build --config server/client/vite.config.mjs && vite preview --open --config server/client/vite.config.mjs
scripts.test: node --test "test/**/*.test.js" && npm run validate-manifest && npm run validate-commands && npm run lint
scripts.update: npm run generate-manifest && npm run release
scripts.all: npm run test && npm run update && npm start
